_comment: Cue list for Squatch Life. Two kinds live here. A cue with `prompt` is a sound effect and goes to ElevenLabs sound-generation. A cue with `say` is a line of dialogue and goes to text-to-speech using the voice named in `voice`, resolved against the `voices` block below. Run `npm run sfx` for everything, `npm run sfx:vo` for just the spoken lines. Any cue without a file falls back to the built-in WebAudio synth, so the game is playable either way.

voices._comment: Every spoken line resolves its voice here, so the character sounds like one person. Paste an ElevenLabs voice id into `id` -- `npm run sfx:voices` lists what is on your account. Nothing spoken will generate until this is set.

player._note: The man who lives here. Mid thirties, flat delivery, talks to himself because there is nobody else in. Not doing a bit -- he is just narrating his own afternoon to an empty room.

announcer._note: 97.8 THE SQUATCH station voice. Adverts, links and the automated overnight. Shouts everything. Low stability and high style on purpose -- this is the one voice allowed to be completely unhinged.

lou1._note: Lou, of Lou & Lou. Breakfast show. Chattier of the two.

lou2._note: The other Lou. Two Lous is the whole premise, so they have to be tellable apart or the joke does not land.

booski._note: Booski. CS gambling show. Has put his rent on a Silver lobby and wants to talk about it.

ape._note: Ape. The straight man to Booski. Delivers legal disclaimers flatly.

irish._note: Irish's Deep Dives. Conspiratorial, confiding, building to nothing. British storyteller voice makes the egg material land harder.

eric._note: Erican, of What's Happening in India. Tries to run a real news segment.

gratin._note: Gratin. Wants to get to the butter chicken. Older, crisper, entirely uninterested in the tech story.

hogmama._note: Hog Mama's Late Night Improv. No script, no plan, and increasingly aware of it.

uncle._note: 98.8 UNCLE SQUATCH BEATS. Smooth, low, unhurried -- the opposite of everything on 97.8.

ksqch._note: 101.7 KSQCH. Scrappy, rough, sounds like it is broadcast out of a garage, because it is.

rippinflow._note: Rippinflow — founder. LOCKED (2026-07-30). Retired freestyler; it keeps happening anyway.

lou._note: Big Uncle Lou on the phone — same man as lou1, phone cadence.

hr._note: PROVISIONAL casting (announcer id) — swap this id and rerun sfx:vo --force --only vo.call.hr to recast.

unknown._note: PROVISIONAL casting (irish id) — the unknown caller. Swap id + regenerate to recast.

old-stove._note: PROVISIONAL casting (uncle id) — pleasant, unhurried, immovable. Swap id + regenerate to recast.

cecilio._note: PROVISIONAL casting (gratin id) — courteous, slow, temperature removed. Swap id + regenerate to recast.

lookout._note: PROVISIONAL casting (eric id) — a man on a hill with binoculars. Swap id + regenerate to recast.

caib-radio._note: PROVISIONAL casting (announcer id) — procedural, bored, filtered. Swap id + regenerate to recast.

margo._note: PROVISIONAL — placeholder casting only, recast before any real recording. Margo Salas runs the kitchen at the Blue Hour: dry, direct, unhurried, fifteen years of talking over extraction fans. Borrowed id from `hogmama` purely so the lines can be auditioned; she is NOT Hog Mama and must not end up sharing a voice with a Circle member.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.high-1.1
sfx.say: Too high.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.high2-1.1
sfx.say: Still too high.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.high3-1.1
sfx.say: Now you’re proving a point.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.low-1.1
sfx.say: Low. Add power before the trees do it for you.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.slow-1.1
sfx.say: Power. Power. POWER.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.fast-1.1
sfx.say: We’re landing here, not in the next country.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.flare-1.1
sfx.say: Hold it off. Hold it. Let her sit down.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.landing.good-1.1
sfx.say: That was a landing. I want that noted somewhere.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.landing.rough-1.1
sfx.say: We arrived before the important pieces fell off. Count it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.landing.bad-1.1
sfx.say: Some of that was flying.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.landing.bad-2.1
sfx.say: Shut it down before anything else agrees to come off.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.cecilio.cecilio.meet-1.1
sfx.say: Grass-fed. Cold-smoked. Forty-two days in mountain air.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.cecilio.meet-2.1
sfx.say: It looks like jerky.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.cecilio.silence-1.1
sfx.say: He’s new.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.cecilio.cecilio.silence-2.1
sfx.say: This is not gas-station meat.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.cecilio.silence-3.1
sfx.say: Understood.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.cecilio.cecilio.silence-4.1
sfx.say: This jerky has lineage.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.brief-1.1
sfx.say: Three crates. Three positions. One in each and she flies like an aeroplane.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.brief-2.1
sfx.say: All three in the back and she flies like a seesaw.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.tail-1.1
sfx.say: Move one forward unless you want the plane climbing before the runway starts.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.nose-1.1
sfx.say: We’re hauling jerky, not trying to drill for oil with the nose.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.strap-1.1
sfx.say: Strap them. Loose cargo is just weight that gets a vote.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.done-1.1
sfx.say: Door shut and latched. Say it out loud so I hear you say it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.lookout.depart.engine-1.1
sfx.say: (radio, urgent) Motor. Two valleys over, coming this way.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.cecilio.depart.engine-2.1
sfx.say: Aeroplane. Bureau. Go now.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.lou-1.1
sfx.say: You’re flying back.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.depart.lou-2.1
sfx.say: I barely landed.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.lou-3.1
sfx.say: And now you’re experienced.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.seat-1.1
sfx.say: Wake me if an engine quits.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.depart.seat-2.1
sfx.say: Which engine?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.seat-3.1
sfx.say: The loud one.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.downhill-1.1
sfx.say: Downhill. The arrow on the barrel is not decoration.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.downhill-2.1
sfx.say: Keep it rolling.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.depart.runway-1.1
sfx.say: We’re running out of runway.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.runway-2.1
sfx.say: Then stop looking at it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.clear-1.1
sfx.say: Cliff. That’s the good kind of nothing underneath you.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.return.river-1.1
sfx.say: Stay near the river.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.return.river-2.1
sfx.say: Why?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.return.river-3.1
sfx.say: Because rivers rarely build towers.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.return.ridge-1.1
sfx.say: Ridge ahead. Left side.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.return.ridge-2.1
sfx.say: The left side has trees.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.return.ridge-3.1
sfx.say: The right side has government.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.return.rain-1.1
sfx.say: Rain. Good. Nobody looks up in it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.caib.caib.sweep-1.1
sfx.say: ...sector four, negative contact, continuing the pattern.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.sweep-2.1
sfx.say: They’re sweeping. Get lower.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.caib.caib.hail-1.1
sfx.say: Unidentified cargo aircraft, alter course and prepare for agricultural inspection.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.hail-2.1
sfx.say: Do not answer.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.caib.hail-3.1
sfx.say: They know we’re here.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.hail-4.1
sfx.say: Knowing and proving are cousins, not twins.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.chase-1.1
sfx.say: Behind us. Don’t climb — climbing is how you introduce yourself.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.chase-2.1
sfx.say: Canyon, cloud, or the saddle in that ridge. Pick one and commit.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.lost-1.1
sfx.say: Gone. Or bored. Both spend the same.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.boundary-1.1
sfx.say: That range behind us is the whole argument. We’re somebody else’s paperwork now.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.engine.hot-1.1
sfx.say: Left one’s running hot. Ease back the left throttle.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.engine.hot-2.1
sfx.say: We need both engines.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.engine.hot-3.1
sfx.say: That is why the plane came with two.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.engine.cooling-1.1
sfx.say: Let it sulk. Fly the other one.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.engine.recovered-1.1
sfx.say: Temperature’s down. Give it half and don’t apologise to it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.home.sight-1.1
sfx.say: That’s the field. Same as you left it, which is the best it does.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.home.sight-2.1
sfx.say: The runway lights are out.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.home.sight-3.1
sfx.say: They have been out since the county discovered invoices.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.home.sight-4.1
sfx.say: How do I see the runway?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.home.headlights-1.1
sfx.say: Community support.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.home.final-1.1
sfx.say: Crosswind from the left. Point the nose into it and land on the wheel that’s low.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.end.bucket-1.1
sfx.say: So that was the job?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.end.bucket-2.1
sfx.say: That was the interview.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.end.bite-1.1
sfx.say: Worth it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.end.envelope-1.1
sfx.say: This is my cut?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.end.envelope-2.1
sfx.say: You’re still a prospect.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-stall-1.1
sfx.say: Nose down! The sky is not holding meetings today!

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-stall-2.1
sfx.say: Nose down. Down. The other down.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-stall-3.1
sfx.say: You’re out of speed and ideas. Fix the speed one.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-overspeed-1.1
sfx.say: Ease off. She starts shedding parts as a hint.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-overspeed-2.1
sfx.say: That noise is the airframe filing a complaint.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-terrain-1.1
sfx.say: Ground. Ground is a solid.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-terrain-2.1
sfx.say: Up. Now would be the time.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-gearHard-1.1
sfx.say: Feel that? That was the landing gear’s entire remaining career.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-banked-1.1
sfx.say: Level it. My coffee has opinions.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-banked-2.1
sfx.say: That’s a lot of angle for a man with my stomach.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-smooth-1.1
sfx.say: That’s better. Keep doing whatever that was.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-smooth-2.1
sfx.say: Good. Boring. Boring is the whole job.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-cargoShift-1.1
sfx.say: Something moved back there. That is never good news.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-patrolClose-1.1
sfx.say: Lower. Trees are free cover and nobody bills you for them.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.there_he_is
sfx.say: There he is. Shoes are wrong, but he’s here.
sfx.direction: Not a greeting. An observation he is happy to have made.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.golf_shoes
sfx.say: Those are golf shoes if you stop respecting golf.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.morning
sfx.say: Morning.
sfx.direction: Flat, warm, complete. He has already said everything he needs to.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.i_noticed
sfx.say: I noticed. That’s why I didn’t call.
sfx.direction: The compliment is buried and he is not digging it up.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.becomes_work
sfx.say: It’s golf. It becomes work around the second bad shot.
sfx.direction: Dry. He is not joking and it is still funny.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.first_tee
sfx.say: For him, that’s the first tee.
sfx.direction: Instant. He had this ready before the sentence finished.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.and_yet
sfx.say: And yet these were the ones you brought.
sfx.direction: Gentle. He is not scoring a point, he is closing a door.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.saving_words
sfx.say: He’s saving his words for the scorecard.
sfx.direction: Filling the silence because somebody has to and it is always him.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.three_clubs
sfx.say: Three clubs. You don’t need seventeen ways to make the same mistake.
sfx.direction: Handing it over without ceremony. Advice about golf and about everything else.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.i_do
sfx.say: I do.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.he_does
sfx.say: He does.
sfx.direction: Confirming a fact, not agreeing with a joke.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.par_three
sfx.say: Par three. One-sixty-seven. Water right, bunker left, dignity everywhere.
sfx.direction: Reading the hole like a man announcing a fight.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.middle_of_green
sfx.say: Middle of the green. Ignore the flag.
sfx.direction: To the Prospect, quietly. The single most useful sentence anybody says today.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.advice_for_both
sfx.say: That advice is for both of you.
sfx.direction: Without looking up from the card.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.know_what_im_doing
sfx.say: I know what I’m doing.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.selected_driver
sfx.say: You have selected a driver.
sfx.direction: Perfectly level. This is how Erican roasts people.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.visualizing_hole_two
sfx.say: I’m visualizing Hole Two.
sfx.direction: Unbothered. It is, in his mind, a complete defence.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.why_am_i_here
sfx.say: So why am I here?
sfx.direction: Asked lightly, because asking it seriously would cost too much.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.invited_you
sfx.say: We can find a fourth. We invited you.
sfx.direction: Low, matter-of-fact, no warmth added. Let the significance arrive after the sentence rather than inside it. He does not look at him.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.that_is_different
sfx.say: That is different.
sfx.direction: Into the silence, after it has gone on slightly too long. He is telling the Prospect what just happened, because Lou never will.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.more_expensive
sfx.say: And more expensive. Lou never pays for the fourth.
sfx.direction: Breaking the moment on purpose, the way friends do.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.rippin_wouldnt
sfx.say: If it was a test, Rippin wouldn’t be administering it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.credentials
sfx.say: I have credentials.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.you_have_clubs
sfx.say: You have clubs.
sfx.direction: The quiet last line. Do not push it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.earned_invitation
sfx.say: You earned the invitation. Morning’s still up for debate.
sfx.direction: The first half is real and he moves past it fast.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.three_holes_rippin
sfx.say: Three holes with Rippin.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.all_love
sfx.say: It’s all love.
sfx.direction: The house phrase. Warm and completely automatic.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.already_not
sfx.say: It is already not all love.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.not_cricket
sfx.say: Erican, this isn’t cricket.
sfx.direction: Heckling for the sake of it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.cricket_rules
sfx.say: Cricket would have more rules and somehow less waiting.
sfx.direction: Mid-address. He does not stop what he is doing to say it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.safe_1
sfx.say: Safe.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.on_the_green
sfx.say: On the green.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.safe_2
sfx.say: Safe.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.yes
sfx.say: Yes.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.watch_this
sfx.say: Watch this.
sfx.direction: Genuine confidence. That is what makes it funny.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.no
sfx.say: No.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.exactly_where
sfx.say: Exactly where I wanted it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.wanted_bunker
sfx.say: You wanted the bunker?

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.information
sfx.say: I wanted information about the bunker.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.you_have_it
sfx.say: You have it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.no_practice_swing
sfx.say: No practice swing?
sfx.direction: Curious rather than cheeky. He is watching how Lou does things.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.practiced_before
sfx.say: I practiced before you got here.
sfx.direction: Already over the ball. It is not a boast.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.oldest_man_shot

sfx.direction: Real admiration disguised as an insult.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.closer_than_yours
sfx.say: It’s closer than yours.
sfx.direction: Walking away as he says it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.all_love_2
sfx.say: It’s all love.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.get_in_the_sand
sfx.say: Get in the sand.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.thirty_seconds
sfx.say: You got thirty fucking seconds before I start coaching.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.nobody_wants_that
sfx.say: Nobody wants that.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.middle_swing_once
sfx.say: Middle of the green. Swing once.
sfx.direction: The only coaching he gives all morning, and it is the same advice Erican gave. That is the point.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.piping_hot
sfx.say: Piping hot.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.that_will_play
sfx.say: That will play.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.pick_up_the_tee
sfx.say: Pick up the tee.

sfx.direction: He has learned that asking is usually a mistake and asks anyway.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.dont
sfx.say: Don’t.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.eleven_months
sfx.say: Eleven months he’s been on it. Eleven.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.hog_mama_bus
sfx.say: Hog Mama drove the bus to Atlantic City. Hog Mama *became* the bus.
sfx.direction: A sentence he has clearly said before and will say again.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.that_is_not_what_happened
sfx.say: That is not what happened.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.thats_how_i_tell_it
sfx.say: That’s how I tell it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.good_ole_days
sfx.say: Good ole days.
sfx.direction: Not nostalgic. Two words, put down like a stone.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.theyre_still_going
sfx.say: They’re still going, Lou.
sfx.direction: Gently. This is Rippin being kind, which he does about once a year.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.i_know_they_are
sfx.say: I know they are. That’s why he’s here.
sfx.direction: He does not look at the Prospect. This is the second time all morning he has said why, and he says it to Rippin instead.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.prospect.ten_drunk_cigarettes
sfx.say: Somebody said something about ten drunk cigarettes.
sfx.direction: Trying it out. Testing whether he is allowed the vocabulary.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.oh_hes_heard
sfx.say: Oh, he’s heard.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.thats_the_second_night
sfx.say: That is the second night, yes.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.one_night_at_a_time
sfx.say: One night at a time.
sfx.direction: Closing it, without any weight on it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.squatch_up
sfx.say: Squatch up, Prospect. It’s a par five, not a funeral.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.let_him_think
sfx.say: Let him think.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.three_shots_to_get_there
sfx.say: Three shots to get there. You have got room to be wrong twice.
sfx.direction: Advice, and permission, in one sentence.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.sallie_j_hit_one
sfx.say: Sallie J hit one out here once. Still going, far as anybody knows.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.nehoo
sfx.say: Nehoo with a guu.
sfx.direction: Under his breath. Not for anybody.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.green_is_long
sfx.say: Green’s long and it runs away from you at the back.
sfx.direction: The read, offered as always without being asked.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.i_like_the_back
sfx.say: I like the back.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.longer_than_it_looks
sfx.say: Everything out here is longer than it looks.
sfx.direction: And he is not talking about the hole.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.two_holes_two_bunkers
sfx.say: Two holes. Two bunkers. There’s a pattern forming and I don’t care for it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.six
sfx.say: Six.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.five
sfx.say: Five.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.six_2
sfx.say: Six.
sfx.direction: Identical to the last time he did this.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.its_all_love_4
sfx.say: It’s all love.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.two_down
sfx.say: Two down. One to go.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.clubhouse_behind_the_last
sfx.say: Last one comes back to the clubhouse.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.so_it_ends_where_it_started
sfx.say: So it ends where it started. Poetic.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.its_a_golf_course
sfx.say: It’s a golf course, Rip. They all do that.
sfx.direction: And the joke lands on the far side of something true.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.last_one
sfx.say: Last one. Everybody still friends?

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.eric.provisionally
sfx.say: Provisionally.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.three_ninety_five
sfx.say: Three ninety-five. Bends left. Clubhouse behind the green.
sfx.direction: Reading the hole, and the last sentence is the one that matters.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.i_can_see_the_bar
sfx.say: I can see the bar from the tee. That’s a design decision.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.eric.there_is_sand_at_two_ten
sfx.say: Sand at two hundred and ten. Right side.
sfx.direction: To the Prospect, not to Rippin.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.two_ten_is_not_a_problem
sfx.say: Two-ten is not a problem for me.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.eric.two_eleven
sfx.say: Two hundred and eleven.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.i_heard_you
sfx.say: I heard you.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.he_did_hear_you
sfx.say: He did hear you.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.you_know_whats_at_seven
sfx.say: You know what’s at seven.
sfx.direction: Not a question. First time either of them has said the hour out loud, and he says it while looking down the fairway.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.prospect.i_know
sfx.say: I know.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.nothing_you_can_do_now
sfx.say: There’s nothing you can do about it between now and then. That’s why we’re out here.
sfx.direction: The whole reason for the morning, stated once, on the last hole, as though it were a small practical matter.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.prospect.what_if_they_say_no
sfx.say: What if they say no?
sfx.direction: Quiet. The question he has been carrying since the car park.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.then_they_say_no
sfx.say: Then they say no, and I still know where you live, and we still play golf.
sfx.direction: Absolutely level. It is the most reassuring thing he could have said.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.but_they_wont
sfx.say: They won’t.
sfx.direction: Two words, thrown away, and he is already walking.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.what_are_we_talking_about
sfx.say: What are we talking about over there?
sfx.direction: From forty yards away, because he cannot bear it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.golf
sfx.say: Golf.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.eric.leave_it_rip
sfx.say: Leave it, Rip.
sfx.direction: And Rippin does, which tells you he understood.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.eric.last_green_of_the_day
sfx.say: Last green. Take a second on it.
sfx.direction: Kind, and the most Erican thing he says all morning.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.im_taking_two_seconds
sfx.say: I’m taking two.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.breaks_toward_the_building
sfx.say: Breaks toward the building. Everything here does.
sfx.direction: The last read he gives, and it is a joke about the club.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.final_accounting
sfx.say: Right. Final accounting. I want my four back from the first.
sfx.direction: Opening negotiations he has already lost.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.no
sfx.say: No.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.didnt_even_think
sfx.say: You didn’t even think about it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.i_thought_about_it_on_one
sfx.say: I thought about it on the first. It’s all love.
sfx.direction: Using Rippin’s own phrase on him. This is Lou being playful.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.eric.that_is_devastating
sfx.say: That is devastating.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.it_is_all_love
sfx.say: It *is* all love. That’s the tragedy of it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.thats_the_round
sfx.say: That’s the round.
sfx.direction: Closing the card for the last time.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.eric.good_morning_for_it
sfx.say: Good morning for it.
sfx.direction: Looking at the sky, meaning something else.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.same_time_next_week
sfx.say: Same time next week, Prospect.
sfx.direction: Said as an ordinary arrangement, which is the single warmest thing anybody says to him all day — because it assumes a next week.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.prospect.ill_be_here
sfx.say: I’ll be here.
sfx.direction: And he means it, and everybody hears that he means it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.seven_oclock
sfx.say: Seven o’clock. Don’t be early.
sfx.direction: The last line of the morning. He is already walking to the car. Do not make it heavy — the whole point is that he says it the way you would tell somebody where to park.
